sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.body: Senshoot Sénégal is responsible for processing the personal data collected through the platform. For any question about this policy or to exercise your rights, contact us at contact@shootsenegal.com.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
sections.body: Photographers: name, email, phone, city, studio description. Clients with an account: name, email. Guest clients (no account): email address only, needed to receive the access link to purchased photos. We also collect order-related data (selected photos, amount, payment method) and, for photographers, the photos they upload as well as booking requests received from clients (name, email, WhatsApp).

sections.heading: 3. Why we use it
sections.body: This data is used exclusively to run the service: create and manage your account, process your orders and payments, send you necessary emails (account confirmation, access to your photos, subscription reminders), connect you with a photographer when you submit a booking request, and keep the platform secure (login attempt limiting, fraud detection).

sections.heading: 4. Who has access to your data
sections.body: We never sell or rent your personal data to anyone. It is only shared with the technical providers necessary to run the service, each with access limited to what their function requires: Supabase (database hosting, authentication, and photo storage), Stripe and KKiaPay (card and mobile money payment processing — Senshoot Sénégal never stores any banking data), Resend (transactional emails), Sentry (technical error monitoring, to fix bugs).

sections.heading: 5. Where your data is hosted
sections.body: These providers host their services internationally, including in Europe and the United States. Each applies its own security and compliance safeguards for international data transfers. No banking data ever transits through or is stored by us — it is handled directly by Stripe or KKiaPay.

sections.heading: 6. Retention period
sections.body: Your data is kept for as long as your account is active. Order-related data is kept beyond that, for as long as needed to meet our accounting and legal obligations. If you delete your account, your personal data is deleted, except for what we must retain for those obligations.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies
sections.body: We only use technical cookies necessary for the site to work: keeping you signed in, remembering your language and your light/dark display preference. We use no advertising cookies or third-party marketing trackers.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
sections.body: Under Senegalese law n°2008-12 on the protection of personal data, you have the right to access, correct, delete, and object to the use of your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@shootsenegal.com. You may also file a complaint with Senegal's data protection authority (CDP – Commission de protection des données personnelles).

sections.heading: 9. Photos and image rights
sections.body: Photographers are solely responsible for making sure they have the necessary permissions (image rights) from the people they photograph before uploading and selling those photos on the platform, including for minors appearing in photos.

sections.heading: 10. Security
sections.body: Access to your data is protected by strict security rules at the database level (each user can only access their own data), your passwords are never stored in plain text, and exchanges with the site are encrypted (HTTPS).

sections.heading: 11. Changes to this policy
sections.body: This privacy policy may be updated; any substantial change will be communicated to you.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: Senshoot Sénégal is a platform that connects professional photographers with clients for the sale of event photos (weddings, baptisms, conferences, graduations, etc.) across Senegal. These terms of use govern access to and use of the platform by any user, whether photographer or client.

sections.heading: 2. Registration and account
sections.body: Creating an event and selling photos requires a photographer account. Buying photos, however, requires no account at all: a client can purchase one or more photos as a guest, simply providing an email address to receive their access link. Each user is responsible for the accuracy of the information provided at registration and for keeping their password confidential.

sections.heading: 3. How the service works
sections.body: A photographer creates an event, generates a public QR code, and uploads their photos, protected by a watermark until purchased. Guests scan the QR code, select the photos they want, and pay online (card or mobile money). Once payment is confirmed, the buyer receives a single-use link to download their photos in high quality, without the watermark.

sections.heading: 4. Pricing and payment
sections.body: Each photographer freely sets the sale price of their photos (500 F CFA minimum per photo). A 10% discount is automatically applied to each photo's price whenever a client buys 2 or more in the same order. Payments are processed by our providers (Stripe for cards, KKiaPay for Wave and Orange Money); Senshoot Sénégal never stores any banking data.

sections.heading: 5. Subscriptions and commission
sections.body: A photographer may, at any time, subscribe to a paid monthly plan or operate without one. The platform takes a commission on each sale, at a rate that depends on the photographer's active plan (70% paid to the photographer with no plan, up to 90% with the top plan). Subscriptions do not renew automatically: the photographer must renew each month to keep the associated rate.

sections.heading: 6. Payouts to photographers
sections.body: A photographer can request a withdrawal of their available balance to Wave, Orange Money, or a bank account at any time. The transfer is carried out manually by Senshoot Sénégal within a reasonable time after the request.

sections.heading: 7. Intellectual property
sections.body: The photographer remains the sole rights holder for the photos they offer for sale. By uploading them to the platform, they grant Senshoot Sénégal a limited right to display, watermark, and sell them on their behalf, solely within the scope of the service. The photographer guarantees they hold all necessary permissions (including image rights of the people photographed) to distribute and sell the photos they upload.

sections.heading: 8. Liability
sections.body: The photographer is solely responsible for the content of the photos they upload and for obtaining any necessary permissions. Senshoot Sénégal acts as a technical intermediary and exercises no editorial control over the photos offered for sale. The platform strives to keep the service continuously available but cannot absolutely guarantee it.

sections.heading: 9. Personal data protection
sections.body: Personal data collected (name, email, phone number) is used solely for operating the service and is never sold to third parties. Any user may request deletion of their account and data by contacting contact@shootsenegal.com.

sections.heading: 10. Termination
sections.body: A user may delete their account at any time by contacting us. Senshoot Sénégal reserves the right to suspend or terminate an account for violation of these terms, including unlawful content or fraud.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to these terms
sections.body: Senshoot Sénégal may amend these terms at any time. Users will be notified of any material change.

sections.heading: 12. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by Senegalese law. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the courts of Dakar.

sections.heading: 13. Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms: contact@shootsenegal.com.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose and scope
sections.body: These sales terms and conditions govern exclusively the purchase of digital photos on Senshoot Sénégal, between a buyer (registered client or guest) and a selling photographer, through the platform. They complement the general terms of use and apply to every order placed on the site, regardless of the payment method used.

sections.heading: 2. Nature of the product sold
sections.body: The products sold are high-quality digital photo files, without watermark, delivered by download. No physical item is shipped. The version visible before purchase (watermarked) lets the buyer confirm their choice before paying.

sections.heading: 3. Price
sections.body: Each photo is sold at the price freely set by the photographer who uploaded it (500 F CFA minimum). A 10% discount is automatically applied to each photo's price once a buyer purchases 2 or more photos in the same order. Displayed prices are in West African CFA francs (F CFA), inclusive of any applicable taxes.

sections.heading: 4. Senshoot Sénégal's role in the sale
sections.body: The photographer remains the seller of the photos they publish: they are the author, set the price, and are responsible for the content. Senshoot Sénégal acts as a technical and commercial intermediary: the platform collects the buyer's payment on the photographer's behalf, deducts its commission (whose rate depends on the photographer's subscription plan, see the terms of use), then pays out the balance to the photographer on withdrawal request. Senshoot Sénégal is neither the author nor the owner of the photos sold.

sections.heading: 5. Payment terms
sections.body: Payment is made online, at the time of ordering, by credit card (via Stripe) or mobile money — Wave or Orange Money (via KKiaPay). No banking data is stored by Senshoot Sénégal: payments are processed directly by these specialized providers. The order is only confirmed once payment is validated by the relevant provider.

sections.heading: 6. Delivery and access to purchased photos
sections.body: As soon as payment is confirmed, the buyer receives a link giving access to their high-quality photos. A client account allows re-downloading purchases at any time, with no limit on the number of downloads, from the "My downloads" area.

sections.heading: 7. No right of withdrawal
sections.body: Given the nature of the product (digital content delivered immediately after payment), the buyer has no right of withdrawal once a photo has been downloaded. By placing an order, the buyer acknowledges and accepts this waiver, in exchange for immediate access to the content.

sections.heading: 8. Refunds and complaints
sections.body: A refund may be requested in the case of a proven technical error: a photo different from the one ordered, a corrupted or unreadable file, a duplicate charge. Any complaint must be sent to contact@shootsenegal.com within 7 days of purchase, stating the order number. For any question about a photo's content (quality, match with the event), the buyer may also contact the photographer directly using the contact details shown on their public page.

sections.heading: 9. Liability
sections.body: The photographer is solely responsible for the quality, content, and accuracy of the photos they sell, as well as for respecting the image rights of the people photographed. Senshoot Sénégal is responsible for the technical proper functioning of the transaction (payment, file delivery) but exercises no prior editorial control over the photos offered for sale.

sections.heading: 10. Governing law and disputes
sections.body: These sales terms are governed by Senegalese law. Any dispute related to a sale that cannot be resolved amicably falls under the jurisdiction of the courts of Dakar.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
sections.body: For any question regarding an order or these sales terms: contact@shootsenegal.com.
